newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel begins freeing female Palestinian inmates.
newsitem.headline: Israel begins freeing female Palestinian inmates.

text.p: Israel began the release on Tuesday of female Palestinian prisoners as part of its peace agreements with the PLO, witnesses said.

A car left Hasharon prison in central Israel with the first of the prisoners to be freed: Lamya Maarouf, 32, a Brazilian citizen who Israeli and Palestinian officials said would be deported to Brazil.
Israel has said it will release on Tuesday 31 female Palestinian prisoners, including women involved in attacks against Jews.

Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, paying hospital visits in the north to soldiers wounded in Lebanon, said the promise to free the women -- two of whom were convicted of murder -- was made originally by the previous Labour government.
